title: Japanese Face Solo #13 (일본 · 20대 · 혀 내밀기(도발) · 메이크업 혼례(연지곤지) 5단계 · 극한 · 피어싱 P50 · 렌즈 코발트 블루(둥근 동공) · 혀 분리된 혀+끝 링 + 금니 그릴)
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, close-up beauty portrait. ONE woman, facing the camera straight on in a perfectly frontal portrait, her head level, both ears clearly visible on either side of her face, framed tightly from the very top of her head down to the base of her neck and the tops of her collarbones, the frame cutting off there. Her face is large and sharp. Mid 20s.

Subject: A real photograph of a striking adult Japanese woman — Japanese fresh natural beauty luminous fair porcelain complexion with a neutral-rose undertone and clear glass-skin glow, mid 20s, hourglass physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — most dramatic hourglass ratio ever, simultaneously maximum enormous bust AND maximum enormous hips both flaring to absolute impossible extremes while the waist is cinched to impossible minimum, a chic black lob with soft layers. Real pores and fine skin grain on her skin, a soft sheen of natural oils, large eyes with bright real catchlights, full lips, pushed to the absolute extreme: an opaque porcelain-white mask-like face, huge blazing crimson yeonji discs spanning both cheekbones, a big glowing red gonji disc on the forehead, ultra-thin sharply arched black brows, tiny lacquer-glossy blood-red lips with a hard painted edge, vivid deep cobalt-blue coloured contact lenses with round natural pupils, both eyes the same, fully opaque and solidly saturated across the whole iris with no natural brown showing through, the colour bright and unmistakable, with a darker limbal ring, sitting naturally on the irises and clear of the eyelids, heavy-lidded eyes with a provocative stare straight into the camera, mouth open with her tongue stuck out and curled up toward one corner of the lips, the tongue deeply forked like a snake's, split down the middle for most of its length, the two pointed tips clearly separated and curling slightly apart, with a small matching metal ring through each fork tip, a gold grill covering the upper front teeth, set with small clear gems, a defiant, provocative expression — a photograph of a real Japanese woman's face (East Asian Japanese features: a soft rounded short face with full cheeks and a small delicate chin, small narrow monolid eyes set slightly wide apart with no crease, a low soft nose bridge with a rounded tip, small modest lips, soft low flat eyebrows), not an illustration, not a render. Her whole face, ears and neck are real living flesh with real pores and fine skin grain, real living eyes with bright catchlights and genuine depth, individual hair strands catching the light 

Piercings: An extreme, dense array of large real metal piercings: a thick bronze septum ring with a smaller bronze ring above it and two bronze rings through each nostril; a straight bronze bar across the bridge of the nose between the brows; three thick bronze bars stacked through the outer half of each eyebrow; a bronze Medusa stud above the lips; a big bronze hoop, two smaller rings and a snake-bite ring on each side through the lower lip's edge, and a row of small hoops through the upper lip's edge; a bronze labret stud and two rings through the chin; a row of small bronze studs along each jaw; a curved row of small bronze studs along each cheekbone; on each ear a full dense row from lobe to top of oversized bronze hoops, thick bars and stretched plugs, the biggest hoops hanging clear of the neck down to the shoulders; and two fine bronze chains looping from the ear hoops to the nostril rings. Each piece carries small diamonds set into the metal. All jewelry is real bronze, sitting in real, calm, healthy skin — no redness, no swelling, no irritation — with a small natural warm shadow under each piece. Every piece stays at least a finger's width from the eyeballs, and no chain or bar crosses the eyes.

Piercing depth: every bar and surface bar is embedded in the skin — its middle runs beneath the skin so only its two end studs show on the surface, the skin between them faintly raised over the hidden bar, with a small warm shadow at each end and nothing lying on top of the skin like a sticker. Every ring passes through a small healed opening in the skin, the skin visible through the loop, and every stud sits through the skin with its back hidden. Where a bar, ring or stud goes through the ear, the lip, the nostril or the brow, it passes through the real tissue with the skin wrapping snugly around it.

Lighting: MANDATORY pure pitch black void background only, absolutely NO studio backdrop NO texture NO grey NO gradient. A soft frontal light on her face and ears, so the glints on every piece of metal read clearly against her skin; a thin cool rim light along the hair and shoulders. 2:3 vertical 8K portrait.
